notes: 02: metadata.mjs collects only title+description; no favicon or preview image. 03: title/description editable after save (edit dialog), but save flow takes only a URL so they cannot be edited before saving. 04: edit dialog changes only title/description and labels can be added, but url is not editable (dialog states address stays), no note field, and tags cannot be removed/edited. 05: no delete endpoint or UI anywhere. 06: duplicate url returns 409 and blocks a second copy, but frontend only shows an error message and does not converge to editing the existing bookmark. 07: card shows title/description/tags but uses a first-letter avatar, no favicon. 10: label entry is a plain text input with no existing-tag autocomplete/datalist. 11: tags render as non-clickable spans; no select-tag-to-filter. 12: search covers title/description/site/labels only; no note field and url matched only via hostname(site), not full url. 14: no #tag syntax parsing. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised groups; plain substring LIKE. 16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. 20: no multi-select or bulk actions. 21: no bulk-to-filter-scope action. 22: list fixed to updated_at DESC; no sort-key selection. 23: no note/markdown storage or rendering. 24: no local HTML/PDF snapshot. 25: no Internet Archive integration. 27: archive is reversible (restore) but delete is entirely missing, so the archive-vs-delete distinction is incomplete. 29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. 30: no Netscape HTML import. 31: no Netscape HTML export. 32: no user display settings (sort/items/font size).
